goal: Define release-grade provider-backed work lifecycle product surface.
risk: AOF may overclaim that a lifecycle product surface proves live provider execution or integration.
loss_boundary: Do not call v10.5 complete if it implies live provider execution, provider integration, or production safety.
evidence_plan: release docs, capability delta, requirement coverage, work execution packet, Council review, runtime audits
stop_conditions: Stop if live provider execution is implied
Stop if production safety is claimed from structural evidence alone
